description_en: Queries all dead-letter messages within a specified Group ID during a specified time range by paging
description_zh: 分页查询指定时间段内 Group ID 内的所有死信消息
kebab_example: aliyun sofa query-mq-sofamq-dlq-message-by-group-id --begin-time 1570723200000 --cell RZ01A --end-time 1570809600000 --group-id GID_test_group_id --instance-id MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --task-id 0BC1310300002A9F000021E4D7A48346 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryMqSofamqDLQMessageByGroupId

parameters.help_en: The beginning timestamp of the query range
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围的起始时间戳
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The ending timestamp of the query range
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围的终止时间戳
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The consumer Group ID to query
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消费端 Group ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID corresponding to the messages to query. This parameter is required for instances that have independent namespaces
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消息所对应的实例 ID。针对有独立命名空间的实例，该参数为必填
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the query task. This parameter is not required for the first query. For subsequent queries, this parameter is required. Obtain the value from the response of the previous query
parameters.help_zh: 查询任务的 ID。首次查询不需要输入，后续获取消息必须传入，根据前一次的返回结果取出该字段
parameters.name: task_id
